findings.title: pal-stdio build context not covered by new .dockerignore security patterns
findings.body: compose.yml keeps pal-stdio on the repository-root build context. The root .dockerignore excludes environment files but lacks the additional key, certificate, secrets, and private-directory patterns added to docker/mcp-servers-source/pal/.dockerignore. This predates the PR and is not a regression; follow-up hardening should cover the root context without broadening this packet.

findings.title: Nested PR proof report path conflicts with the canonical schema pattern
findings.body: schemas/proof/embedded_audit.schema.json permits one directory segment below proof/, while the established PR Steward convention stores reports under proof/pr_merge/embedded-audit/pr-<N>/. scripts/audit/local_audit_acceptance.py intentionally allows the trusted emitter to override report_path. Resolving this structural mismatch requires a separate schema or convention change.

findings.title: Standalone PAL reference catalog remains materially ahead of the vendored catalog
findings.body: The standalone PAL fork carries additional OpenAI and OpenRouter catalog entries and dynamic-selection behavior outside this packet. Shared reviewer fixes are synchronized, but full catalog convergence remains separate work.

findings.title: Usage extraction returns zero for one non-integer total_tokens edge case
findings.body: If a provider exposes total_tokens but the value is non-integer, _extract_usage records zero instead of input_tokens plus output_tokens. Current provider response fixtures do not exercise this shape.
